note: Consensus answer (match first, then cards) is near-universal and given via rate comparison and single examples; academic co-holding literature quantifies costs at population level but no historical-returns backtest of pause-vs-continue was found. Novelty is limited because the answer is near-mechanical at 20%+ APR; a backtest would mostly confirm the consensus.
